about_pullquote: I started this business to do honest electrical work at fair prices.
about_para_1: K H Electrical Services has been serving Liverpool homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started with a simple mission: provide reliable, professional electrical work without the inflated bills or jargon. Today, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing problems properly, and fixing them right.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because they trust us. Whether it's a minor repair, a full rewire, or an emergency at midnight, we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own. We're locally based in Liverpool, fully qualified, and we stand behind every job we do.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a problem with the electrics in my kitchen, didn't know what was wrong. Called K H and they came out the next morning. Diagnosed it straight away, fixed it, and didn't charge me a fortune like other electricians quoted. Brilliant service, will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Our office in the city centre had a complete rewire done last year. They were professional, tidy, and kept disruption to a minimum. Work finished on time and everything's been solid since. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Called at 11pm with a blown fuse and water near the fuse board—proper scary. They came within the hour, made it safe, and spent time explaining what happened. No judgment, no extra charges. Exactly what you need in an emergency. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David L.
